<!--
PR title = the squash commit = the changelog entry. It must follow Conventional Commits,
the "PR title" check enforces it:  <type>(<optional scope>): <summary>

  feat      new user-facing feature              → minor release, listed under "Features"
  fix       bug fix                              → patch release, listed under "Bug Fixes"
  perf      performance improvement              → patch release
  deps      dependency update                    → patch release
  revert    reverts an earlier change            → patch release
  docs / refactor / test / ci / build / chore    → no release, not in the changelog
  feat!: … (or a "BREAKING CHANGE:" footer)      → major release

The summary is shown to club members in the app ("What's new"), so write it for them,
e.g. "feat(treasury): show per-evening penalty sums in account history".
-->
